answer_1.quote: Extended summary generation has been of research interest very recently.

answer_2.quote: Our choice of ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L is based on the fact that these express higher similarity with human judgments.

answer_4.quote: For the sake of evaluation, two annotators were asked to manually evaluate two sets of 40 papers' groundtruth abstracts (40 for arXiv-Long, and 40 for PubMed-Long) with their generated extended summaries (baselines' and ours) to gain insights into qualities of each model.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to specify if the first system-generated summary wins/loses or ties with the second system-generated summary in terms of qualitative metrics: (1) Cohesion: whether the ordering of sentences in summary is cohesive, namely sentences entail each other. (2) Completeness: whether the summary covers all salient information provided in the ground-truth summary.
